    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)

    pattern = [[1 if grid[r][c] == 8 else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = out[r][c+w] = pattern[r][c]*8
    return out
